title: Slot Text
description: A dependency-free text roll for small labels: each letter rolls out of a clipped slot while the next rolls in, with a springy settle and an optional hue sweep. The classic Copy to Copied button.

props.name: text
props.description: The text to show. Change it to roll the changed letters to the new text.

props.name: options
props.description: Roll options, read when the text changes: `direction` ("down" | "up", default "down"), `rollBy` ("character" | "word"), `stagger` (45 ms), `duration` (300 ms), `exitOffset` (50 ms), `easing` (an overshooting back curve), `bounce` (0.6: per-letter timing and tilt), `color` (a CSS color or `(index, count) => color`, such as `chromatic()`), `colorFade` (280 ms), `skipUnchanged` (true) and `interrupt` (true).

props.name: respectReducedMotion
props.description: Swap the text without the roll when the user prefers reduced motion.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Text for assistive technology when it should differ from `text`.

a11y: The text is kept once as visually hidden text for screen readers; the rolling letter cells are aria-hidden, so a roll is never read letter by letter.
Inside a button the label is the button's name. A roll is not announced on its own: pair a change such as Copy to Copied with a polite status message, as the demo does.
With the default respectReducedMotion, the text swaps without the roll when the user prefers reduced motion.
dir="auto" keeps the letters of Latin text in order inside a right-to-left page; each grapheme is its own cell, so scripts whose letters join (Arabic) lose their joining while they roll.
